parole.significato: ahamkara (the ego in Hinduism)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sanskrit अहंकार (ahaṃkāra).

parole.significato: anusvara (Devanagari diacritic)
parole.testo: From Sanskrit अनुस्वार (anusvā́ra).

parole.significato: Aryan (member of the ancient Indo-European people who settled in the Indus valley)
parole.testo: From Sanskrit आर्य (ā́rya, “noble" or "noble one”).

parole.significato: cannabis (plant or drug of the species Cannabis sativa)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sanskrit भङ्ग (bhaṅga, “hemp”).

parole.significato: karma (the total effect of a person’s actions and conduct during the successive phases of his existence)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sanskrit कर्मन् (karman).

parole.significato: chakra (spiritual energy nexus)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sanskrit चक्र (cakrá, “wheel, circle, point”), ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *kʷékʷlos (“circle, wheel”). Doublet of ciclo.

parole.significato: dharma (principle that orders the universe)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sanskrit धर्म (dhárma, “that which upholds or supports”).

parole.significato: Devanagari (the Devanagari abugida script)
parole.testo: From Sanskrit देवनागरी (devanāgarī), compound of देव (deva, “deity, divine”) + नगर (nagara, “town, city”).

parole.significato: dalit (outcasts within traditional Hindu society, falling outside the fourfold varna system, historically often segrega…
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sanskrit दलित (dalita).

parole.significato: guru (spiritual teacher)
parole.testo: From Sanskrit गुरु (gurú, “venerable, respectable”), originally "heavy", from Proto-Indo-European *gʷréh₂us. Doublet of bruto.

parole.significato: yoga (a Hindu and Buddhist discipline)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sanskrit योग (yoga, “yoking, union”), from Proto-Indo-European *yewg- (“to join”). Related to jugo (“yoke”).

parole.significato: fruit of the plant Syzygium jambos; rose apple
parole.testo: From Sanskrit जम्बु (jambū, “rose apple, jambul”).

parole.significato: mantra (a phrase repeated to assist concentration during meditation)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sanskrit मन्त्र (mantra).

parole.significato: naja (any snake of the genus Naja)
parole.testo: From Sanskrit नाग (nāgá, “serpent, snake”).

parole.significato: nirvana (complete cessation of suffering)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sanskrit निर्वाण (nirvāṇa, “blown or put out, extinguished”), from निस् (nis, “out”) + वा (vā, “to blow”).

parole.significato: the pardo, a coin formerly used in India
parole.testo: From Sanskrit प्रताप (pratāpa), which was written on the coins.

parole.significato: Prakrit
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sanskrit प्राकृत (prākṛta).

parole.significato: soma
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sanskrit सोम (sóma), from Proto-Indo-Iranian *sauma, from Proto-Indo-European *sew(h)-.

parole.significato: svarabhakti; anaptyxis (epenthesis of a vowel)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sanskrit स्वरभक्ति (svarabhakti, “vowel separation”), a compound of स्वर (svara, “vowel”) + भक्ति (bhakti, “separation”).

parole.significato: sandhi (fusion of sounds across word boundaries)
parole.testo: Learned borrowing from Sanskrit संधि (saṃdhí).

parole.significato: Sanskrit (language)
parole.testo: From Sanskrit संस्कृत (saṃskṛta, “perfected, prepared, constructed, refined”).

parole.significato: vaishya (the third-highest ranking caste within the fourfold varna system of traditional Hindu society, consisting of f…
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sanskrit वैश्य (vaiśya).

parole.significato: balcony, veranda, terrace
parole.testo: Uncertain due to apparent cognates in both Indo-Aryan and Romance. parole.significato: varna, the four original castes of traditional Hindu society.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sanskrit वर्ण (varṇa, “colour, tint, dye, pigment, appearance, aspect”).

parole.significato: a pointed stick (such as an arrow or spear) whose head has been hardened by fire
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sanskrit शर (śara). Compare Spanish jara.

parole.significato: shudra (the fourth and lowest-ranking (excluding dalits) caste within the fourfold varna system of traditional Hindu so…
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sanskrit शूद्र (śūdra).

parole.significato: kshatriya (the second-highest ranking caste within the fourfold varna system of Hindu society, consisting of warriors a…
parole.testo: From Sanskrit क्षत्रिय (kṣatriya, “(the warrior or military caste or a member of this caste”), from क्षत्र (kṣatra, “rule, dominion, authority”). Akin to sátrapa.

parole.significato: Aryan (relating to the Aryans or their language)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sanskrit आर्य (ārya).
